svg.text: BEST FOR: WHEN TO USE WHAT
DYNAMIC TEMPLATE • MOVING ARROWS & LIVE PACKETS
Routing Policy: Which Model (Gemini or Open Weights), Which Tools, and Which Mode for Every Turn
Three deterministic gates decide safety mode, reasoning tier, and parallelism before a single token is spent — enforced by ADK or LiteLLM, never by the prompt.
Taint tracking runs before model selection; it can
only remove capabilities, never add them.
Flash or Gemma 3 handles ~80% of turns; Argon or a
70B open model is reserved for complexity > 0.75.
Independent read-only tools always fan out;
mutating tools never run in parallel.
ADK model router or LiteLLM keeps the tiering
B: Deep reasoning only when needed
Curated by Nitin Aggarwal • Google Cloud ADK + OpenHands Factory • Proprietary + Confidential
Sources: Rule 55 Vertex AI routing • LiteLLM router • vLLM / Ollama • IDEA-08 • IDEA-09
